uncertainty: Outcome-contrast std is descriptive variation across repeated splits; conditional_se is within a fixed fitted subgroup and does not account for fitting/selection. Reused records do not create independent trials.
constraint_scope: Minimum support and treatment fraction apply to discovery and selection; the maximum-coverage cap is enforced only on selection. Test values are diagnostics, not filters.

paired.contrast_definition: train_only_minus_legacy_full holds hard filtering fixed; revised_pipeline_minus_historical also changes legacy selection to hard selection.

megafon.interpretation: Provider-generated synthetic competition data; contrasts are descriptive; treatment randomization not independently verified.
